challenge.name: AI Income Challenge (Iman Gadzhi)
challenge.note: UK times. 12:00 / 13:00 Eastern, running 7-15 Nov. Links arrive by email from imangadzhi@consulting.com, so check Promotions.

pushback: Treat the challenge as a free source of tactics, not a plan. These challenges usually end with a paid upsell. Decide your budget ceiling before Day 5 so the pitch doesn't decide it for you. Your edge isn't 'AI'. It's that you're a Bayes REI student with a CBRE IM seat who has cold-emailed 60+ REPE professionals with a decent reply rate. Sell what only you can make.

ideas.title: REPE cold-outreach playbook + templates
ideas.why: You've run 60+ researched cold emails with ~25% warm replies. Students pay for proven scripts, trackers and the research method.

ideas.title: Real estate modelling templates (acquisition, DCF, waterfall)
ideas.why: Built while you study. Sells on Gumroad / Etsy / Whop to students and junior analysts. Also proves skill to recruiters.

ideas.title: REPE interview flashcard / case-study pack
ideas.why: You're already making flashcards for Jarvis. Package the technicals (IRR, waterfall, cap rates, debt metrics) into an Anki / Notion pack.

ideas.title: Notion career OS (application + networking tracker)
ideas.why: You already run this system in Notion. A template is quick to package and low effort to sell.
